title: Deprecation Concierge & Compatibility Gateway for Legacy Model Versions
creator: Nina Roberts
description: Create a customer-first deprecation workflow that combines automated notices, a migration concierge experience, and an internal compatibility gateway to safely retire old model versions while preserving application continuity. The system should publish clear performance profiles for replacement models and provide per-customer migration recommendations and rollback paths.
background: We routinely introduce new model variants and performance-optimized builds. Customers sometimes continue to rely on older model versions, which increases maintenance surface area (back-compat shims, regression monitoring) and dilutes capacity. Current deprecation notices are one-size-fits-all and lack tailored migration guidance or programmatic warnings. Engineering has asked for a more structured cadence and signals to power automated routing and pin suggestions.
goals: Reduce classes of production incidents caused by unexpected model retirement by 80% for affected customers
Provide timely, personalized migration guidance and a concierge review for top 50 revenue customers
Publish machine-readable performance profiles for every replacement model and expose compatibility tags so SDKs and routing policies can make safe substitutions
Automate customer-facing notices and SDK/runtime warnings 30/15/7 days before any irreversible change
scope: Design and deliver a deprecation orchestration flow that includes: automated multi-channel notifications, a migration concierge offering (email + CS handoff for high-value customers), a compatibility gateway service to map old model behavior to suggested replacements, performance profile publishing, and SDK/runtime signals to surface pin recommendations and soft-fallbacks.
out_of_scope: Mandating customers to migrate automatically without explicit opt-in, changing pricing tiers, or building full compatibility emulation of old model weights beyond simple adapter shims.
acceptance_criteria: Automated notice pipeline sends templated 30/15/7-day notices and records delivery status
Compatibility gateway returns at least two candidate replacement models with semantic and perf deltas for any deprecated model version
Console shows a per-model ‘replacement score’ and per-customer migration task list
SDK runtime surfaces a non-blocking warning on pinned calls and suggests recommended pin replacements
Migration concierge staffing plan and handoff process documented and tested with 3 pilot customers
tasks: Draft customer-facing notice templates and review with legal and trust
Define compatibility gateway API contract (input: deprecated model id + usage fingerprint; output: candidate models + perf/profile deltas)
Instrument telemetry to detect pinned usage and create per-customer migration signals
Publish standardized performance profile schema and backfill for the top 25 replacement models
Implement SDK warning banner and non-fatal telemetry event for pinned deprecated models
Build Console migration UI: per-customer checklist, expected regression matrix, and scheduling helper
Coordinate with CS to run concierge pilot for three customers and capture feedback
Create rollback/cutover runbook and validate with a staging sunset
milestones: M1: Requirements sign-off and API contract (2025-02-28)
M2: Compatibility gateway MVP + perf profiles published (2025-03-21)
M3: SDK warnings and Console migration UI soft-launch (2025-04-07)
M4: Concierge pilot complete and playbook finalized (2025-04-14)
M5: Full workflow enabled for scheduled EOL events (2025-04-21)
Target EOL window for first legacy model batch: 2025-06-01 to 2025-06-30
success_metrics: % of affected customers migrated or pinned to recommended replacements within 90 days >= 70%
Reduction in post-deprecation SEVs attributable to model changes >= 80% in next quarter
Open rate of deprecation emails >= 60% for targeted segments
Number of support tickets created per deprecated model decreases by 50% after concierge engagement
risks: Customers using custom fine-tuned weights may not be able to adopt suggested replacements quickly
Compatibility gateway could surface false-positive safe matches leading to quality regressions
Concierge throughput may be insufficient for spike in enterprise migrations
Legal/contract customers may require bespoke timelines increasing operational load
notes: Compatibility gateway should be designed to be read-only and advisory for first rollout — no automatic rewrites to customer traffic
Performance profiles must include token-latency P50/P95, cost per 1k tokens, mean semantically equivalent score on canonical eval set
For Dedicated/Private customers, notices should include deployment-specific instructions and API compatibility checks
Consider adding a deprecation flag in model metadata that surfaces via the models catalog and SDK
